battle.name: 伊拉克戰爭
battle.theater: 伊拉克南部至中部戰線
battle.brief: 2003年3月19日美英聯軍發動打擊，二十六天內自科威特推進至巴格達，四月二日奪取國際機場。卡面的加特林機槍誕生於一百四十年前，六管原理仍在戰場：人力轉輪換成電動旋轉，成為黑鷹直升機門邊的M134迷你砲與阿帕契鼻砲塔的M197三管砲。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 伊拉克戰爭的交戰方分成明顯不對等的兩層。開戰方是美國主導的多國聯軍，行動代號「伊拉克自由」：美軍投入約十四萬八千人，英國皇家海陸空軍約五萬人，澳洲約兩千人，波蘭軍警特種部隊不足兩百人，另有二十餘國只提供醫療、海上護衛、運輸與後勤技術支援。聯軍最高指揮是美軍中央司令部司令湯姆·弗蘭克斯，戰區分由第十八空降軍、聯合特遣隊與中央司令部海軍部隊指揮；英軍方面由空軍元帥彼得·斯奎爾任聯軍地面部隊指揮，第1裝甲師負責南部主攻，海軍在南面實施兩棲佯攻。伊拉克一方是薩達姆·侯賽因以總統兼最高指揮官身分親自掌握的國家暴力機器：常備軍約三十八萬至四十萬人，轄七個步兵師，另加共和國衛隊數個機械化與步兵師、武裝警察、內政部快速反應部隊、情報機構特別安全局，以及政黨武裝「薩達姆敢死隊」與什葉派民兵。伊拉克空軍只有數十架可作戰戰機，真正構成抵抗重量的是地面部隊的蘇聯制式裝甲與迫擊砲。北部另有庫爾德武裝與土耳其邊境的海灣邊境防衛隊；南部陸路由英軍與美軍封鎖，海上航線則靠英國、澳洲與波蘭海軍巡邏關閉。
countriesEn: The opposing sides in the Iraq War split into two conspicuously unequal layers. The side that opened the war was the US-led coalition, operation Iraqi Freedom: some 148,000 American personnel, roughly 50,000 British service members from the Army, Royal Navy and Royal Air Force, about 2,000 Australians, fewer than 200 Polish special forces, and medical, maritime escort, transport and technical support elements from more than twenty further countries. Overall command rested with General Tommy Franks at US Central Command, while on the ground the theatre was divided among XVIII Airborne Corps, the joint task forces and CENTCOM's naval component; for the British, Air Chief Marshal Sir Peter Squire commanded the coalition ground forces, the 1st Armoured Division taking the southern main effort and the Royal Navy mounting an amphibious demonstration off Basra. The Iraqi side was the state coercive apparatus held directly by Saddam Hussein in his dual capacity of president and commander-in-chief: a regular army of some 380,000 to 400,000 men spread across seven infantry divisions, several mechanised and infantry divisions of the Republican Guard, the armed police, the Interior Ministry's Rapid Response Force, the Special Security Service intelligence apparatus, and the party armed wing, Saddam's Fedayeen, together with Shi'i militia. The Iraqi air force had only a few dozen serviceable combat aircraft, and it was the ground forces' Soviet-pattern armour and mortars that carried the real weight of resistance. In the north, Kurdish armed groups and the Turkish border's gendarmerie operated separately, while the southern approaches were sealed on land by British and American forces and the sea lanes were closed by British, Australian and Polish warships.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩邊。美國方面，總統喬治·W·布希在2003年3月16日發表講話，宣布給伊拉克四十八小時的最後通牒，3月19日晚下令開始打擊；國防部長唐納德·拉姆斯菲爾德主張以軍事手段一舉解決伊拉克，參謀總長休·戈登與參謀長聯席會議主席理查德·邁爾斯是計劃背後的技術推手；中央司令部司令湯姆·弗蘭克斯負責具體指揮，第十八空降軍司令戴維·彼得雷烏斯率領空降與地面部隊指向伊軍左翼，101空降師師長彼得·奇亞雷利、陸軍第3步兵師師長大衛·麥基爾南、第2海軍陸戰遠征旅旅長詹姆斯·康威分別掌握西線、中線與南線的縱深突進。卡爾巴拉方向，陸軍第3步槍團第2營營長威廉·斯特林中校所率的「史密斯特遣隊」在3月29日遭伏擊，第1營營長麥基爾南中校同日亦在車隊中遇襲；納西里亞方向，第3步兵師第2旅旅長約翰·塞普爾韋達上校指揮的「里帕爾特遣隊」在4月9日遭共和國衛隊機械化部隊重創。伊拉克方面，薩達姆本人以總統兼武裝部隊總司令主持一切，其長子烏代伊與次子庫賽伊在首都與南部督戰；參謀長穆罕默德·達巴格准將代表軍方與聯軍談判，共和國衛隊各師師長分掌南線與中部，情報與政黨武裝體系負責清剿與動員，而西部前線的第1、第5步兵師則在邊境一線遲滯聯軍。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities lay on both sides. On the American side, President George W. Bush delivered the address of 16 March 2003 granting Iraq forty-eight hours, and ordered the opening of fire on the evening of 19 March; Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld argued for solving Iraq by military means in one stroke, while Chief of Staff Hugh Gordon and Joint Chiefs Chairman Richard Myers supplied the technical drive behind the plan. General Tommy Franks at Central Command held operational command, with Lieutenant General David Petraeus at XVIII Airborne Corps directing the airborne and ground effort against the Iraqi left, Major General Peter Chiarelli commanding the 101st Airborne Division, Major General David McKiernan the 3rd Infantry Division, and Major General James Conway the 2nd Marine Expeditionary Brigade, each controlling one of the three axes of advance. In the Karbala sector, the 2nd Battalion, 3rd Infantry Regiment under Lieutenant Colonel William String, whose Task Force Smith was ambushed on 29 March, and the 1st Battalion commanded by Lieutenant Colonel McKiernan, which was struck the same day, suffered the sharpest losses of the drive; in the Nasiriyah sector, Task Force Ripper under Colonel John Sepulveda, commanding the 3rd Infantry Division's 2nd Brigade, was badly mauled by Republican Guard mechanised forces on 9 April. On the Iraqi side, Saddam himself presided over everything as president and commander-in-chief of the armed forces, with his elder son Uday and younger son Qusai directing operations in the capital and the south; Chief of Staff Brigadier General Muhammad al-Dabbagh negotiated with the coalition on behalf of the military, the Republican Guard divisional commanders holding the south and the centre, and the intelligence and party militia apparatus responsible for internal security and mobilisation, while the 1st and 5th Infantry Divisions on the western front delayed the coalition along the border.
kits: 本卡兵器是1860年的加特林機槍，而2003年的伊拉克戰場上沒有任何一名士兵手動搖動這種轉輪機；但它的原理幾乎原封不動地活了下來，並且正是以機炮與機載武器的形式決定了這場戰役的樣子。加特林的核心是「多管分次後坐」：六根管子繞軸旋轉，後坐力被分散到六次射擊上，因此不必用機身去硬扛整發炮的後坐。這個原理在二十世紀被兩種方式繼承：一是火控化的鏈式或轉管機炮，二是把轉輪直接電動化。戰場上最常見的是6管M134迷你砲，口徑30×113公釐，由電動馬達帶動，最高每分鐘約三千發，炮口初速約每秒850公尺，有效射程可達一至二公里，供彈以2000發鏈式彈帶或50發圓形彈鼓裝填，廣泛掛載於UH-60黑鷹直升機的左右艙門、CH-47支奴干直升機尾部的機砲塔以及AH-1武蜥直昇機上；阿帕契AH-64的機鼻轉塔內則是3管30公釐的M197，其B套件另含M230鏈式砲，但那不是加特林，兩者常被混淆。海軍方面，20公釐6管M61火神構成密集砲CIWS近程防空系統，裝在巡洋艦與驅逐艦上。全套主戰裝備方面，聯軍以M1A1與M1A2艾布拉姆斯主力坦克、M2布萊德利步兵戰鬥車、悍馬與M1117裝甲車、M109A6帕拉丁155公厘自走砲、M270多管火箭砲與海爾瑪斯構成地面打擊骨幹；空中有AH-64D長弓阿帕契（配地獄火飛彈與Longbow雷達）、F-16C與F-16D、F/A-18C與F/A-18D、A-10攻擊機、B-1B與B-52、加油機、預警機與Predator無人機；遠程打擊由戰艦的戰斧巡航飛彈、JDAM導引炸藥與JASSM空射巡航飛彈完成。伊拉克軍的裝備則是純蘇聯系：T-72與T-62主力坦克、BMP-1與BMP-2步兵戰鬥車、ZSU-23-4自行高炮、SA-2與SA-3地空導彈、四十七管BM-21火箭砲、122與152公厘榴炮，以及由皮卡車改裝的技術車。加特林的後坐分散原理在這些裝備上同樣成立：M1A2的主砲迴轉座是液壓伺服而非旋轉管；只有M134與M197這類多管機關把加特林的原始構念完整保留下來，成為護衛車隊的近距火力核心。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the Gatling gun of 1860, and no soldier in Iraq in 2003 cranked a rotary cannon by hand; yet the principle survived almost intact, and it was precisely in the form of autocannon and airborne weapons that it shaped the campaign. The core of the Gatling is the distribution of recoil across several barrels: six tubes revolving about an axis so that the recoil of a single shot is spread over six firings, so the mount does not have to absorb the whole recoil by brute strength. In the twentieth century that principle was inherited in two forms, a fire-controlled chain or rotary cannon, and the direct electrification of the rotor. The most common of these on the battlefield was the six-barrel M134 Minigun, calibre 30x113 mm, driven by an electric motor, up to about 3,000 rounds per minute cyclic, muzzle velocity around 850 metres per second, effective range one to two kilometres, fed by a 2,000-round link belt or a 50-round disposable drum, and mounted ubiquitously on the side doors of UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters, on the pintle mount of CH-47 Chinooks and on AH-1 Cobras. Inside the Apache AH-64's nose turret sat the three-barrel 30 mm M197, whose B kit also carried the M230 chain gun, a different weapon that is routinely confused with it. On the naval side the 20 mm six-barrel M61 Vulcan formed the Phalanx CIWS close-in defence system fitted to cruisers and destroyers. The wider equipment order of battle ran on M1A1 and M1A2 Abrams tanks, M2 Bradley fighting vehicles, Humvees and M1117 armoured vehicles, M109A6 Paladin 155 mm self-propelled howitzers, M270 multiple rocket launchers and HIMARS for the ground; in the air, AH-64D Longbow Apaches with Hellfire missiles and the Longbow radar, F-16C and D, F/A-18C and D, A-10s, B-1Bs and B-52s, tankers, airborne early warning aircraft and Predator UAVs; and for standoff strike, Tomahawk cruise missiles from warships, JDAM guided bombs and JASSM air-launched cruise missiles. The Iraqi inventory was purely Soviet-pattern: T-72 and T-62 tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, ZSU-23-4 self-propelled anti-aircraft guns, SA-2 and SA-3 surface-to-air missiles, 47-tube BM-21 rocket launchers, 122 and 152 mm howitzers, and pickups converted into technicals. The same logic of recoil distribution applies to all of it: the M1A2's main gun traverses on a hydraulic servo, not on revolving tubes. Only the M134 and the M197 carried the original Gatling concept intact, and they became the close-range core of convoy escort fire.
tactics: 聯軍的戰術可以一句話概括：以縱深打擊換時間，再以速度換政治效果。開戰首日（3月19日晚）以海陸空聯合的「震懾」火力開場，伊拉克空軍在頭兩天內幾乎全數在地面被摧毀，能升空作戰的只有零星數機，聯軍因此在第三天即取得完全制空權；此後每日維持逾一千架次的出動架次，頭六週合計超過四萬一千架次，其中逾九千架次是空中加油。第一波攻勢不是全面推進，而是三路縱深插入：西線由第101空降師、第82空降師與第173空降支隊沿西部沙漠邊緣直插摩蘇爾方向，中線由第3步兵師沿幼發拉底河與高速公路走廊推進，南線由英軍第1裝甲師與美軍第2海軍陸戰遠征旅指向巴士拉。第187空降團戰鬥群在3月21日完成一次逾兩千人的空投，車輛與物資同步落下，落地即向艾爾福與納西里亞方向展開，使聯軍在南部縱深比伊拉克軍的預判快了數天。空中是「砧與錘」：AH-64阿帕契與OH-58武裝直升機、UH-60黑鷹組成空中騎兵，與第3步兵師的地面縱隊保持數公里距離，進行搜索、辨識、轉移、交戰的完整鏈條，直昇機門邊的M134迷你砲與阿帕契的M197在護衛與近距支援中扮演火力節點，協助車隊在火箭筒與迫擊砲的伏擊線中殺出血路。地面作戰分成三種速度：南線第1裝甲師高速穿插，英軍第3步兵團等單位在3月23日自海灣登陸巴士拉方向形成兩棲與空中配合的夾擊；中線第3步兵師在納西里亞選擇「清剿—控制—建立」的城市戰程序，逐屋清空而非單純越過；北線的美軍與海軍陸戰隊則被伊拉克軍遲滯於摩蘇爾方向。伊拉克軍以拖延與消耗為主：技術車在村鎮間機動發射火箭筒與迫擊砲，步兵在道路與建築殘骸間伏擊車隊，共和國衛隊機械化師在納西里亞與卡爾巴拉方向實施反擊，並在南部油田大量埋設炸藥，試圖以斷油與斷路遲滯聯軍推進。
tacticsEn: The coalition method can be summed up in one line: trade depth of strike for time, and then trade speed for political effect. The opening night of 19 March was a combined naval, ground and air bombardment, and within the first two days the Iraqi air force was almost entirely destroyed on the ground, only a handful of aircraft getting airborne, which handed the coalition complete air superiority by the third day; the tempo then held above a thousand sorties a day, with more than 41,000 sorties in the first six weeks, over 9,000 of them tankers. The first wave of attack was not a general advance but a three-pronged insertion in depth: in the west the 101st Airborne Division, the 82nd Airborne Division and the 173rd Airborne Brigade drove along the desert fringe towards Mosul; on the centre the 3rd Infantry Division advanced along the Euphrates and the highway corridor; in the south the British 1st Armoured Division and the US 2nd Marine Expeditionary Brigade pointed at Basra. On 21 March the 187th Airborne Regimental Combat Team put more than two thousand men down in a single drop, vehicles and supplies falling with them, and drove immediately for Al-Faw and Nasiriyah, reaching the southern depths several days ahead of Iraqi expectations. In the air the doctrine was anvil and hammer: AH-64 Apaches, OH-58 armed scout helicopters and UH-60 Black Hawks formed the air cavalry, riding a few kilometres from the 3rd Infantry Division's ground columns and running the full chain of search, identify, decide, engage. The M134 Minigun on the helicopter door and the M197 in the Apache's chin turret became the fire nodes of convoy escort and close air support, killing their way through lines of rocket-propelled grenade and mortar ambush. On the ground the battle ran at three different speeds. In the south the 1st Armoured Division made a fast penetration, with British units such as the 3rd Infantry Regiment landing from the sea on 23 March to close the trap on Basra in concert with airborne and air attacks. On the centre the 3rd Infantry Division chose urban clear-hold-build at Nasiriyah, clearing house by house rather than simply passing through. In the north American and Marine forces were held up on the Mosul axis. The Iraqi army fought to delay and to attrit: technicals roved between towns firing rocket-propelled grenades and mortars, infantry ambushed columns among ruins and wrecked buildings, Republican Guard mechanised divisions counter-attacked towards Nasiriyah and Karbala, and mines were laid extensively in the southern oil fields in an attempt to cut oil and roads and slow the coalition advance.
data: 時間線：2003年3月19日晚聯軍打出第一波彈藥，3月20日地面部隊自科威特與沙特邊境全面展開；3月21日第187空降團戰鬥群在西部空降，第3步兵師攻入伊拉克南部並切斷艾爾福半島退路；3月23日至24日納西里亞戰役爆發；4月2日第3步兵師第3旅奪取巴格達國際機場，第101空降師攻入國際會議中心；4月5日聯軍進入巴格達市中心；4月9日納西里亞戰役達到高潮，同日巴格達菲爾多斯廣場的薩達姆銅像被拉倒；4月13日第3步兵師宣稱控制全城；5月1日布希在「亞伯拉罕·林肯」號航母上宣布「任務完成」；12月13日薩達姆·侯賽因在提克里特附近被捕。兵力：開戰前送抵科威特一線的部隊約二十萬人，其中美軍約十四萬八千、英軍約五萬、澳軍約兩千、波蘭特種部隊不足兩百。空襲：頭六週聯軍出動逾四萬一千架次，其中逾九千架次為加油架次，美國空軍承擔兩萬四千架次以上，頭幾日每日逾一千架次。推進距離：科威特至巴格達的公路約一千公里，第3步兵師自3月20日至4月2日用十三日推進約八百公里，第101空降師與第173空降支隊的西路行程更長。傷亡：美軍陣亡一百四十八人，其中一百三十九人在戰鬥中陣亡，受傷約兩千人；英軍陣亡三十三人、受傷一百一十五人；伊拉克軍方死亡人數各方估算差距極大，公開研究多落在七千至二萬之間，亦有更高的說法；投降與被俘的伊拉克軍人以數萬計。裝備與破壞：聯軍在南部攻勢中繳獲或摧毀伊拉克數百輛坦克與數千輛裝甲車，另有約四百口油井在開戰前被埋設炸藥。
dataEn: Timeline: the coalition flew the first rounds of ammunition on the evening of 19 March 2003, and on 20 March the ground forces went in from the Kuwaiti and Saudi borders; on 21 March the 187th Airborne Regimental Combat Team dropped in the west while the 3rd Infantry Division entered southern Iraq and cut the retreat from the Al-Faw peninsula; the battle of Nasiriyah broke out on 23 and 24 March; on 2 April the 3rd Infantry Division's 3rd Brigade seized Baghdad International Airport and the 101st Airborne Division stormed the International Convention Centre; on 5 April coalition forces entered the centre of Baghdad; on 9 April the battle of Nasiriyah reached its climax and, the same day, the statue of Saddam was pulled down in Firdos Square; on 13 April the 3rd Infantry Division declared the city fully controlled; on 1 May Bush declared mission accomplished aboard USS Abraham Lincoln; on 13 December Saddam Hussein was captured near Tikrit. Manpower: some 200,000 troops were sent forward to the Kuwait line before the war, of whom about 148,000 were American, 50,000 British, 2,000 Australian and fewer than 200 Polish special forces. Air: more than 41,000 coalition sorties in the first six weeks, over 9,000 of them tanker sorties, the US Air Force flying more than 24,000 of the total and over a thousand sorties a day in the opening days. Distance: the road from Kuwait to Baghdad runs about a thousand kilometres, and the 3rd Infantry Division covered roughly eight hundred of them in the thirteen days from 20 March to 2 April, with the 101st Airborne Division and 173rd Airborne Brigade covering further still on the western axis. Casualties: 148 Americans dead, of whom 139 were killed in action, and about two thousand wounded; 33 British dead and 115 wounded. Iraqi military deaths are estimated very differently by different sources, most public studies falling between seven thousand and twenty thousand, with higher claims also in circulation; Iraqi soldiers surrendering or taken prisoner ran into the tens of thousands. Equipment and destruction: several hundred Iraqi tanks and several thousand armoured vehicles were captured or destroyed in the southern offensive, and about four hundred oil wells had been mined with explosives before the war began.
cause: 打起來的原因有國際法、戰略與國內政治三層。國際法層面，安理會第1441號決議（2002年11月8日）認定伊拉克未完全履行裁軍義務，並警告不遵從者「可能需要使用武力」；2002年12月巴格達把聯合國武器核查團趕出伊拉克，使核查機制癱瘓，美方因此認定談判已無可能。戰略層面，9·11之後美國把反恐戰線指向中東，宣稱伊拉克擁有大規模殺傷性武器並與基地組織有關聯；1991年海灣戰爭留下的兩個禁飛區由英美空軍巡邏了十二年，卻未能迫使巴格達裁軍、裁撤共和國衛隊或放棄核計畫；開戰前的外交清單則是在聯合國框架內尋找合法性，包括9月19日布希在安理會的講話與3月16日的最後通牒。國內政治層面，執政當局需要一場快速的決定性勝利來兌現競選承諾，而海灣地區預置的基地、預先徵召的後備役與已建立的空運與海運通道，使整條時間表得以壓縮到數週之內。聯盟的形成同樣是有代價的交換：英國以「道德理由」換取美國承諾在安理會背書，德國與澳洲以兵力換取在聯合國的席位。最終3月17日安理會投票，十五票贊成、敘利亞與北韓反對、俄羅斯與中國棄權；決議沒有賦予進攻合法性，但美軍也不需要它，需要的只是沒有人否決。
causeEn: The reasons for fighting ran on three levels: international law, strategy and domestic politics. At the legal level, Security Council Resolution 1441 of 8 November 2002 found Iraq not fully compliant with its disarmament obligations and warned that non-compliance could lead to the use of force; in December 2002 Baghdad expelled the UN weapons inspection teams, paralysing the inspection mechanism, and Washington concluded that negotiation was no longer possible. At the strategic level, after 11 September the United States drove its counter-terrorism line through the Middle East, asserting that Iraq possessed weapons of mass destruction and had ties to al-Qaeda; the two no-fly zones left over from the 1991 Gulf War had been patrolled for twelve years by British and American aircraft without forcing Baghdad to disarm, disband the Republican Guard or abandon its nuclear programme; and the diplomatic shopping list before the war consisted of attempts to find legitimacy inside the United Nations, including Bush's address to the Security Council on 19 September and the ultimatum of 16 March. At the domestic political level, the administration needed a quick and decisive victory to cash in the promises of the campaign, and the pre-positioned bases in the Gulf, the pre-called reserves and the air and sea lift already in place allowed the whole timetable to be compressed into a few weeks. Building the coalition was itself a trade: Britain offered a moral justification in exchange for American sponsorship at the Security Council, while Germany and Australia contributed forces in exchange for a seat at the United Nations table. On 17 March the vote in the Security Council ran fifteen in favour, Syria and North Korea against, Russia and China abstaining. The resolution conferred no authorisation to attack, and the Americans did not need it; what they needed was for no one to veto.
impact: 戰爭的直接後果是伊拉克國家機器的重組與戰區秩序的長久改變。政治上，安理會第1483號決議（3月22日）設立「聯合國過渡管理當局」，由保羅·布魯默任行政長官，廢除舊政權的法律而代之以聯軍主導的臨時法規；以「清洗」為名的第1號命令解職黨與安全部門數萬人，第2號與第3號命令解散伊拉克軍與共和國衛隊，三十八萬餘名軍人解散回家，數十萬件步槍、手槍、迫擊砲與數千件重裝備流入黑市，其中相當一部分後來出現在阿富汗、索馬里、黎巴嫩、也門、剛果民主共和國與哥倫比亞，成為2000年代游擊戰爭的主要物資來源；軍隊重建延後到2004年才以命令第3號附則的方式進行，規模限制在八萬五千至十萬人。軍事上，伊拉克空軍與海軍解體，領空長期由聯軍管制，民間航空在數年內幾近停擺；作戰理論上，「震懾」與縱深打擊的樣板成為此後十年美軍的正式教義，而伊拉克的持久戰反過來逼出2006年的《敵後戰爭手冊》與「小足跡」反叛亂理論。長期後果則是2004年開始的教派武裝衝突、2006年後逐步擴大的內戰、2011年美軍全面撤出、2014年伊斯蘭國佔領摩蘇爾，以及2016年收復摩蘇爾時聯軍仍需投入數千兵力的尷尬迴圈。
impactEn: The immediate consequences were the reconstruction of the Iraqi state machinery and a lasting reordering of the region. Politically, Security Council Resolution 1483 of 22 March created the Coalition Provisional Authority, with Paul Bremer as its administrator, abolishing the old regime's laws in favour of coalition interim regulations. Order No. 1, styled a de-Ba'athification, dismissed tens of thousands of party and security officials, while Orders No. 2 and No. 3 disbanded the Iraqi army and the Republican Guard: more than 380,000 soldiers were demobilised, and hundreds of thousands of rifles, pistols, mortars and several thousand heavier weapons flooded the black market, a substantial share of which later turned up in Afghanistan, Somalia, Lebanon, Yemen, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Colombia, becoming the principal materiel supply of the insurgencies of the 2000s. Reconstruction of the army was not begun until 2004, under the addendum to Order No. 3, and was capped at 85,000 to 100,000 men. Militarily, the Iraqi air force and navy ceased to exist, the airspace remained under coalition control for years and civil aviation came close to a standstill. In operational doctrine, shock and awe and the model of strike in depth became official US teaching for the following decade, while the Iraqi insurgency worked in the other direction, forcing the 2006 Counterinsurgency Manual and the small-footprint counterinsurgency theory. The long-term consequences run from the sectarian armed conflict that began in 2004, through the civil war that deepened after 2006 and the American withdrawal of 2011, to the Islamic State's seizure of Mosul in 2014 and the uncomfortable cycle whereby the coalition still had to commit several thousand troops to retake the city in 2016.
result: 結果分三層。軍事上，伊拉克軍與共和國衛隊在二十六天內瓦解：第11師在納菲爾方向被第3步兵師第1旅夜襲打崩，共和國衛隊第51與第52機械化師在南部沿幼發拉底河被分割，英軍第1裝甲師與第2海軍陸戰遠征旅在巴士拉方向切斷退路，4月13日第3步兵師宣布控制巴格達全城，第101空降師佔領菲爾多斯廣場，薩達姆的銅像在4月9日被拉倒，同日海軍陸戰隊工程兵在廣場上架起鋼構、升起旗桿。4月初巴格達的抵抗相當一部分來自黨武裝與什葉派民兵，而非正規軍，這也預告了後續數年的游擊戰格局。政治上，薩達姆於12月13日在提克里特附近被捕，2004年至2006年受審，2006年底被處決；政權被美軍解散，臨時政府於2003年底接手，2005年通過新憲法並舉行選舉，2006年由馬利基組閣；2003年12月31日安理會第1542號決議終止過渡管理當局、將主權交還伊拉克，2004年春巴士拉與薩馬拉一線的武裝抵抗曾迫使聯軍推遲部分交權程序。戰術與技術層面，M134迷你砲與阿帕契的M197在護衛與近距支援上的表現確立了武裝直升機在城市與反叛亂環境中的地位，也讓人重新記起加特林那句原理——多管分次後坐。直到2011年美軍撤出，2003年3月那些裝備仍在倉庫與裝甲車上。
resultEn: The outcome falls into three layers. Militarily, the Iraqi army and the Republican Guard came apart in twenty-six days: the 11th Division was broken in a night attack by the 3rd Infantry Division's 1st Brigade near Najaf, Republican Guard's 51st and 52nd Mechanised Divisions were cut apart along the Euphrates in the south, the British 1st Armoured Division and the US 2nd Marine Expeditionary Brigade sealed the retreats towards Basra, on 13 April the 3rd Infantry Division declared the whole of Baghdad controlled, and the 101st Airborne Division occupied Firdos Square, where Saddam's statue was pulled down on 9 April and Marine engineers raised a steel structure and its flagpole the same day. The resistance inside Baghdad in early April came in substantial part from party militias and Shi'i formations rather than from the regular army, which prefigured the pattern of the years of insurgency that followed. Politically, Saddam was captured near Tikrit on 13 December, tried between 2004 and 2006 and executed at the end of 2006; his regime was dismantled by the Americans, a transitional government took over at the end of 2003, a new constitution was passed and elections held in 2005, and al-Maliki formed a government in 2006. Security Council Resolution 1542 on 31 December 2003 ended the Coalition Provisional Authority and handed sovereignty back to Iraq, and armed resistance around Basra and Samarra in the spring of 2004 forced the coalition to postpone part of that handover. At the tactical and technical level, the performance of the M134 Minigun and the Apache's M197 in escort and close air support established the place of armed helicopters in urban and counter-insurgency environments, and reminded everyone of the old Gatling proposition: recoil distributed over several barrels. And when the Americans finally withdrew in 2011, the equipment of March 2003 was still sitting in warehouses and in armoured vehicles.
